name: vue3-boundarize-monorepo
description: highly customizable component for resizing nested content

scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter vue3-resize-bounding test:unit run && pnpm --filter react-resize-bounding test:unit run && pnpm --filter resize-bounding-demo test:unit run
scripts.test:ui: pnpm --filter vue3-resize-bounding test:ui run && pnpm --filter react-resize-bounding test:ui run && pnpm --filter resize-bounding-demo test:ui run
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm prepare && pnpm --filter resize-bounding-demo run deploy:dev && pnpm --filter vue3-resize-bounding run deploy:docs:dev && pnpm --filter react-resize-bounding run deploy:docs:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm prepare && pnpm --filter resize-bounding-demo run deploy:prod && pnpm --filter vue3-resize-bounding run deploy:docs:prod && pnpm --filter react-resize-bounding run deploy:docs:prod
